# GDCT Dark

GDCT Dark is a dark theme with consistent styling and balanced contrast, presented for extended writing and note review. Interface elements are described as unobtrusive so attention stays on the content, and the theme index records dark mode only.

![GDCT Dark screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bcdavasconcelos/Obsidian-GDCT_Dark/HEAD/gdct.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "GDCT Dark"
    author: "bcdavasconcelos"
    repo:   "bcdavasconcelos/Obsidian-GDCT_Dark"
    slug:   "gdct-dark"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/gdct-dark"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/bcdavasconcelos/Obsidian-GDCT_Dark"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bcdavasconcelos/Obsidian-GDCT_Dark/HEAD/gdct.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply a dark, readable theme with clean, consistent styling and balanced contrast for extended writing and note review. Keep interface elements unobtrusive to help you focus on content."
}
```
